verdict.rationale: CoreWeave docs confirm Spot Node Pools exist as pay-as-you-go, no-commitment bare-metal capacity with a Capacity Finder tool to check availability, and pricing page mentions 'burst On-Demand or Spot capacity' with 'great pricing,' but the evidence never documents specific discount percentages or preemption/interruption semantics (notice period, how workloads are terminated, SLA guarantees) that an ML engineer would need to plan around interruptions. Missing for 10: documented discount rate vs on-demand, explicit preemption notice/grace period, and interruption handling guidance.
